name: Elealeh
overview: Elealeh is a town mentioned in the Old Testament as part of the territory involved in Israelite settlement and conflict. Initially taken by the children of Reuben, alongside neighboring towns such as Heshbon and Kirjathaim, Elealeh is also noted in prophetic lamentations describing its distress under Moabite control, where its voice and harvest cries are heard amid sorrow and warfare. These passages highlight Elealeh's significance in the historical and spiritual struggles between Israel and Moab.
